# fflate 0.8.3

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/fflate/-/fflate-0.8.3.tgz
Upstream: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

`fflate-0.8.3.min.js` is the unmodified `package/umd/index.js` distribution.
EPUB imports use only the synchronous ZIP reader, without workers or remote scripts.
